_doc: Knockabout modes. `rounds` = round WINS needed to take the match (first to N). Difficulty sets the default CPU level and how tough wave goons are.

modes.name: Versus
modes.blurb: Everyone for themselves. Last one standing takes the round.

modes.name: Teams
modes.blurb: Two to four teams. Last team with anyone standing takes the round.

modes.name: Waves
modes.blurb: Team up against waves of goons. Toss them all out to clear a wave; anyone knocked out comes back next wave.
modes._goonsDoc: goons in wave n = max(min, round(players * (perPlayer + growth * (n-1)))), capped so the arena holds at most maxFighters. Every toughEvery waves they take one more punch to knock down. A goon takes punchesToDown + toughStart + (waves so far / toughEvery) + difficulty goonTough punches (never fewer than 1).
